mechanism: send_code() checks the per-recipient daily limit, delivers the message, and only then stores the new count, so deliveries that fail after being billed are never counted and a second run that passes the check during a delivery is billed as well.
why_unseen: The findings were a daily review cap on billed model calls recorded in a ledger, a success-only record and an opt-in flag; this is an in-process per-recipient limit on billed message sends, and the control reserves the count under a lock before delivering and keeps it when delivery fails.
